summary: # World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.35.0 Release Notes
body:
版本 v0.35.0 发布，包含游戏底层架构迭代与前期核心系统打磨。

# World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.35.0 Release Notes
**Release:** v0.35.0
**Date:** 2026-08-07
**Previous release:** v0.34.0
Version 0.35.0 is the PvP release. Thornhollow Fields opens as a ranked 5v5
capture-the-flag battleground with its own honor economy, gear tier, and rank ladder.
Alongside it, the character creator was rebuilt modular, swimming became a real system
instead of a wade animation, professions moved to cast-paced crafting with a player
commission board, and pets stopped being second-class citizens. Under the hood the
animation pipeline learned to blend pose samples, which unlocked bespoke ability casts for
